segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר שבליל שבועות הוא העיקר התעוררות השינה שלא לישן כל הלילה ובהו"ר העיקר האמירה "שבועות איז דער עיקר דאס הוף זיין אין הושיתא רבא איז דער עיקר דאס זאגין".
segments.en: Reb Noson wanted to tell Rabbainu his own dream — that he had been engaging with Rabbainu in the Torah of chapter ten. But before he could, Rabbainu said: "You do not need to tell me — I myself know, for you are the one who answered and said the proof from be'terua d'ika rucha." After this, Reb Noson took Rabbainu's shofar and would blow it himself the entire month of Elul — and only on Rosh HaShanah would he give the shofar to the community. And specifically Reb Meir Leib Blechir would blow on it. After Moharan'as's passing, Reb Yitzchak son of Moharan'as took the shofar — and when he traveled to the Holy Land he took it with him to Tzfas the holy city. And the shofar remained in Tzfas — and also Rabbainu's chalat [garment] and belt remained there.
